performance.verdict: No paid activity; organic GBP cliff drop warrants immediate investigation.

findings.text: Zero paid spend across all 28 days — Meta and Google Ads both completely dark. No leads generated; CPL is undefined with no active paid engine.
GBP actions collapsed 88.24% last 7d vs prior 7d: last 3 days (Aug 31–Sep 2) show 0 actions vs 12 actions in the prior 3 days (Aug 28–30), confirming a sharp, sustained organic drop.
GA4 sessions spiked to 28 on Sep 1 — an outlier vs the 3–13 daily baseline over 45 days — then dropped back to 8 on Sep 2. Likely a single referral event, not a trend.
GHL pipeline data is null across the 28-day window, so no intake funnel visibility exists. With 0 leads, this is a data gap, not a confirmed leak — but it must be resolved before paid reactivation.

suggestions.text: Audit GBP listing immediately — 0 actions for 3 straight days after 12 in prior 3 days signals a listing issue or suspension.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped 88.24% in 7d, with the last 3 days (Aug 31–Sep 2) recording 0 actions versus 12 in the preceding 3 days. Check the Google Business Profile dashboard for any suspension notices, ownership conflicts, or listing edits that may have suppressed visibility. Success check: GBP actions return to at least 3/day within 7 days of fix. Re-check by 2026-09-10.

suggestions.text: Reconnect GHL pipeline reporting — null data blocks intake-leak diagnosis before any paid reactivation can be assessed.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL pipeline shows null across the entire 28-day window, making it impossible to confirm whether any organic inquiries are being captured in the CRM. Verify the GHL integration is active and that lead sources are mapped correctly. Success check: pipeline data visible in next performance pull. Re-check by 2026-09-10.

suggestions.text: Hold all paid reactivation; watch GBP recovery and GHL data for 7 days before assessing paid channel restart.
suggestions.monday_update: With zero paid spend for 28+ days and the only active organic channel (GBP) now dark for 3 consecutive days, restarting paid ads before fixing organic visibility and CRM reporting would add spend with no diagnostic baseline. Monitor GBP action recovery and GHL pipeline connectivity. Re-evaluate paid reactivation readiness on 2026-09-10.
